verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents service tokens as a distinct credential type usable to authenticate the hosted MCP server for headless agents/CI, and the CLI supports creating/listing/showing individual tokens — evidence of a scoped, non-interactive credential mechanism for agents. However, the evidence never details granular permission/role scoping (e.g., read-only vs full-access token grants) that would confirm true least-privilege configurability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable token scopes/roles, independent/hands-on confirmation of least-privilege enforcement.
